comment: The py leg skip baseline (#582). Every expected skip, BY NAME, with its attribution.
tests/run.js fails an unfiltered gate whose skip set differs from this file in either
direction: a skip not listed here means a test silently stopped running; a listed skip
that did not happen means the gate retired or the test vanished. Either way the SAME
commit that changes the skip set updates this file — one line per gate.
exemptPrefixes: fuzz/live-<seed> skips are csmith-generated with random names and
depend on the native leg (0-5 per run where ~/git/csmith exists) — unbaselineable.
Guard: tests/host/test_skip_baseline.js. Measured 2026-08-08 on the #582 lane.

projects.projects/cpython-clang: compiler.js cannot build CPython yet: todos/0327 (the GNU __extension__ keyword, which Modules/_hacl's krml headers use and which blocks the whole hashlib family) and todos/0336 (startup cost) both gate it. This bin.json is NOT dead — the sibling clang-simplified manifest reads its `sources` to build the shipped cpython-clang payload (the sibling's own project/app name is still `python-clang` until its manifest renames — todos/0374 merge-time step). Drop these two keys when 0327/0336 land; todos/CPYTHON.md §4.3 is the two-consumers contract.
